note: One order-free rule set: 0 disagreements at the fixpoint, 0 subsumptions. Forward-phase kernels are 100% mapped and draft-phase kernels 99.9%; the unmapped draft remainder is the copy + index launch after the last MTP step. Forward operations exclude the unified.mtp.* copy of their slot suffix; draft operations (mtp.*, phase draft) claim the mtp.step_0 and mtp.recurrent copies together. The FlashKDA q/k/v .contiguous() copies and beta transpose belong to kda.chunk_prefill, as the vllm_flashkda L1 kind times them. dsa.glue owns the dsa.glue, dsa.indexer_glue and dsa.prefill_glue placeholders together. dsa.sparse_mla is the one FA3 call per layer (prepare_varlen, mainloop and combine), and the 64-wide query zero fill is dsa.sparse_mla.q_rope_zero_fill. The draft metadata rebuild and input prep are mtp.step_glue. The draft logits all-gather and its concat copy are mtp.logits_gather, a synchronizing collective against an elementwise placeholder slot. Preprocess, sample plumbing and bookkeep stay explicitly unmapped. The exceptions are the sample-phase lm_head GEMM, which is mapped, and the sample logits all-gather, which is labeled as an unmapped synchronizing collective. Lone one-kernel repeat bodies of the KDA split gathers and FlashKDA copies are labeled by the <none>/<none> sentinel; in this capture no other forward kernel of those names folds that way. The sparse-MLA backend is the arch's sparse_mla_backend. dsa.sparse_mla also owns FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90's one BatchMLAPageAttentionHopperKernel per layer; its per-call _pack_topk_indices is dsa.sparse_mla.pack_indices (FA3's query zero fill stays dsa.sparse_mla.q_rope_zero_fill). Each of the two prep operations lists both backends' prep slots, because rule bodies resolve against the run's cost manifest whether or not they fire and a manifest carries only the selected backend's slot. FlashInfer's per-plan _clamp_work_kv_end is mtp.step_glue in the draft phase and stays unmapped in preprocess.
